entities.name: Query IspD/IspF
observations: A 404-residue sequence matches reviewed bacterial bifunctional IspD/IspF proteins with 70.6–86.7% identity and 98.5–99.5% query coverage.
Pfam scanning identifies IspD PF01128 at residues 11–234 and YgbB PF02542 at residues 244–396; an NTP_transf_3 domain is also detected.
The enzyme is annotated to require a divalent metal cation; exact metal identity is not established by the sequence analysis.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate + CTP + H+ = 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol + diphosphate; EC 2.7.7.60; Rhea RHEA:13429.
This is the IspD activity in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway.

entities.name: ME-CPP synthase reaction
observations: This is the IspF activity in the methylerythritol phosphate pathway.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The two activities correspond to steps 2/6 and 4/6 of isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis via the 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate pathway.
